description: Source code for the BidiExecutionContext class, which implements js.ExecutionContextDelegate for handling script evaluation, property access, and node management via the BiDi protocol in Playwright.

classes.name: BidiExecutionContext
classes.description: Implements script evaluation and DOM interaction via BiDi protocol for Playwright.

methods.name: rawEvaluateJSON
methods.description: Evaluates a script expression in the remote context and returns the deserialized result.

methods.name: rawEvaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a script expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: evaluateWithArguments
methods.description: Calls a function with arguments in the remote context, returning either a value or a handle.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves enumerable properties of a handle as a map.

methods.name: releaseHandle
methods.description: Disowns a handle in the remote context.

methods.name: nodeIdForElementHandle
methods.description: Gets a shared node ID for an element handle.

methods.name: remoteObjectForNodeId
methods.description: Retrieves a remote element handle from a node ID.

methods.name: contentFrameIdForFrame
methods.description: Gets the frame ID for a content frame handle.

methods.name: frameIdForWindowHandle
methods.description: Gets the frame ID for a window handle.

methods.name: _remoteValueForReference
methods.description: Internal method to get remote value for a reference.

methods.name: _rawCallFunction
methods.description: Internal method to call a function in the remote context.
